summary: Executed backend + frontend validation for Lulu super-admin credential panel, encrypted persistence, safe OAuth connection handling, auth hardening regression, and private-storage regression. Backend suites passed (18/18). UI found one reproducible defect: sandbox environment toggle does not switch from production, so warning text and effective saved environment remain production-only through the panel.

ui_bugs.issue: Sandbox environment button is not taking effect; warning banner remains production and production button stays active after clicking sandbox.

integration_issues.issue: UI cannot reliably switch to sandbox mode, which blocks intended environment selection behavior before save/test.

action_items: Fix Lulu environment toggle state update in Settings so sandbox selection visibly activates and updates warning text.
Re-test save path after sandbox selection to confirm PUT sends environment='sandbox' from UI.
After fix, rerun UI checks for both 1920x1080 and 390x844 to ensure no regression in overflow or control states.
critical_code_review_comments: Lulu admin APIs enforce super-admin authorization (403 for regular users) and do not return plaintext or encrypted credential fields in status/save responses.
Credential persistence correctly uses encrypted fields and unique (provider, owner_id) semantics; overwrite behavior keeps a single row.
Malformed JWT handling now returns HTTP 401 (no server exception) in exercised regression tests.
INTEGRATION_CREDENTIALS_KEY is read from runtime env only; .env patterns are ignored by repository-level .gitignore.
Note: Lulu print-job submission remains outside this scope and is still MOCKED in existing pre-task flow as stated in handoff context.

success_rate.frontend: 93% (core Lulu settings/auth visibility checks passed except sandbox toggle)

seed_data_creation: Created disposable TEST_iter22_lulu_* and TEST_iter22_regular_* accounts; cleaned backend test users via fixtures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression and Lulu credential security checks are green; primary remaining issue is frontend sandbox selector behavior. Reproduce by super-admin login -> /settings -> click [data-testid='lulu-environment-sandbox']; warning remains production and production button remains selected.
rca of the issue: RCA (UI): Environment selector click does not transition component state to sandbox in repeated runs. Observable symptoms: warning copy remains production, production button remains active class, and sandbox never reflects selected state. Likely front-end state wiring/event handling issue within LuluIntegrationCard environment buttons path; backend API itself supports sandbox when payload is sent directly.
